title: F900XR Adventure Sport (Track Edition)
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the BMW Motorrad F900XR Adventure Sport (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 900cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
